data.headline: Preschool activities, picture schedules and parent communication
data.summary: They work with a preschool group, plan weekly activities and lead nature-based learning projects. They use picture schedules to support transitions and communicate with parents through regular updates, Wilma and Daisy.

signals.rendering: They work as a childcare assistant with a preschool group of six-year-old children.
They plan weekly activities according to the early childhood education plan.
They lead projects where children collect leaves and practise counting and sorting them.
They created a picture schedule with a child to make outdoor transitions easier.
They give parents weekly updates and use digital tools for messages.
They use Wilma to send messages to parents.
They use Daisy for parent messages and the attendance list.
